_comment: Budgets for scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs (kB). Initial = what index.html loads before the shell renders. Lazy chunks (editor, terminal, graph) and media are reported but deliberately not budgeted here. 185 -> 186 in 1.40: the settings store (two files, migration hooks, live settings.json reload) and the Mod+, shortcut; the registry and settings UI stay lazy. 186 -> 188 in 1.41: cluster names, colours and environment badges in the sidebar and context switcher at first paint (cluster metadata) and the window tint; the hub, guardrails, setup guide and provider marks stay lazy. 188 -> 191 in 1.42: the auth center core (credential state, recovery fan-out to watches/logs/port forwards, status refresh) and auth error classification, needed by every view at startup; the sign-in dialog, toasts, badges, notice, add-cluster dialog and vault prompts stay lazy. CSS 18 -> 18.5 in the design pass: Tailwind emits one stylesheet for every screen, lazy or not, and the calmer hub, settings, dialogs and setup guide use classes the old screens didn't (startup JS went down 1.9 kB in the same pass).
